items.title: Medical Laboratory Technologist
items.institution: Islami Bank Hospital and Cardiac Centre, Mirpur, Dhaka
points: Perform routine and advanced microbiological testing on blood, urine, sputum and swab specimens.
Identify bacterial pathogens and run antimicrobial susceptibility testing following CLSI guidelines.
Carry out hematology, biochemistry, molecular, immunology, urinalysis and transfusion-medicine procedures.
Maintain quality control and records; support physicians and infection-control teams.
Train junior staff and interns in standard techniques and safety protocols.

items.title: Medical Laboratory Technologist
points: Prepared blood components: PRBC, FFP, platelet concentrate, cryoprecipitate and washed cell suspension.
Performed plasma and platelet apheresis and assisted in Therapeutic Plasma Exchange (TPE).
Operated automated blood grouping and crossmatch systems.
Performed antibody screening, Rh antibody detection and titration, DCT, ICT and Du test.

items.title: Medical Laboratory Technologist
points: Collected and processed blood and other biological specimens across core laboratory sections.
Performed quality control on test results to ensure validity and accuracy.
Calibrated and troubleshot testing systems and instruments.
Kept records and reports and followed safety and infection-control procedures.

items.title: Scientific Officer ( Medical Laboratory)
points: Oversee daily laboratory activities and ensure accurate, timely, and efficient diagnostic testing.
Ensure proper collection, handling, processing, storage, and disposal of clinical specimens.
Perform and supervise laboratory investigations in microbiology, hematology, biochemistry, immunology, and molecular diagnostics.
Maintain laboratory quality standards, perform internal quality control, and support external quality assessment activities.
Monitor laboratory equipment performance, ensure proper maintenance, and follow biosafety and infection prevention protocols.
Review and validate test results, maintain accurate laboratory records, prepare reports, and support clinical teams with reliable diagnostic information.
